title: PHP2Shell: two unauthenticated PHP core RCEs exploited in the wild, still not in CISA KEV
why: watchTowr reports in-the-wild exploitation via its honeypot network and Cloudflare reported early attacks; a leaked PoC circulated before the patch. watchTowr's FAQ still lists CISA KEV as 'not listed' (checked 19:15Z Oct 21). Missing on Microsoft's side: no KEV entry (non-Microsoft product, MSRC n/a).
action: Upgrade every internet-facing PHP to 8.5.12/8.4.27/8.3.36/8.2.35 (or the distro backport) and restart all PHP workers; where that is impossible, apply PHP's interim settings (memory_limit=-1, session.upload_progress.enabled=0) or isolate the app, and capture memory evidence before restarting suspected hosts.

title: LiteLLM 1.107.0 supply-chain compromise: stolen cloud credentials now being abused
why: Wiz reports the attacker validating AWS instance-role credentials stolen from compromised CI runners and Kubernetes nodes between 16:20 and 17:01 UTC on Oct 21; JFrog, Mend, Aikido and The Hacker News document the stealer. No CVE, nothing in CISA KEV and no Microsoft advisory.
action: Search lockfiles, build logs and container history for litellm 1.107.0 or Oct 21 pulls of latest/main-latest/main-stable; treat matching hosts as compromised, rebuild on litellm==1.106.2 pinned by hash/digest, and rotate every secret they could read, starting with LLM provider keys and cloud role credentials.

title: FortiSIEM unauthenticated gRPC path traversal to RCE: public PoC, still not in CISA KEV
why: Horizon3 published working exploit code (GitHub horizon3ai/CVE-2026-106173) and a deep dive. Fortinet says it is not known to be exploited and it is not in CISA KEV (re-checked 19:15Z Oct 21). Earlier FortiSIEM bugs from the same researchers drew exploitation within days of disclosure.
action: Upgrade FortiSIEM 7.5.0 to 7.5.1+, block tcp/27918 from untrusted networks, and check timestamps on /opt/charting/redishb.sh and /opt/phoenix/bin/phLicenseTool for unexpected changes.

title: Cisco Unified CM / Emergency Responder / Unity Connection hardening release: critical unauthenticated auth-bypass and injection CVEs
why: Cisco disclosed critical issues from an internal security review in cisco-sa-voice-hardening-twgbH9e3, now published in NVD: CVE-2026-76474 (improper authentication, CVSS 9.8 AV:N/PR:N) and CVE-2026-76473 (CWE-74 injection, 9.8). Vendor disclosure only: no PoC or exploitation seen and not in KEV.
action: Inventory Unified CM / Unity Connection / Emergency Responder clusters and apply the fixed releases listed in cisco-sa-voice-hardening-twgbH9e3; until then make sure their management interfaces are not reachable from the internet.
